body:
Citrus AMMO Nicotine Pouches is a tobacco-free nicotine pouch from AMMO, made for adults who want a discreet alternative with no smoke, no vapor and no device to charge. Each can is sealed for freshness and focuses on tangy citrus brightness with a soft sweet finish.

Citrus AMMO Nicotine Pouches is listed at $5.99 - $29.95 in our Nicotine Pouches range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Nicotine Pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name Citrus Fruit points to tangy citrus brightness with a soft sweet finish. Taste is subjective, and the same flavor can read sweeter or sharper depending on the device and your own palate, so use this as a starting point.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** AMMO
- **Category:** Nicotine Pouches
- **Flavor:** Citrus Fruit
- **Nicotine strength:** Standard 9mg, Strong 12mg, Magnum 15mg
- **Capacity:** 15-20 Pouches/Can
- **Packaging:** Single, 5 Pack
- **Price:** $5.99 - $29.95
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Sealed can:** keeps the pouches fresh and the flavor consistent until you open it.
- **Portable:** a slim can fits easily in a pocket or bag.
- **Clear strength options:** strengths are listed so you can compare cans and choose the level that suits you.

### Strength and size options
This listing offers more than one option — strengths Standard 9mg, Strong 12mg, Magnum 15mg and pack sizes Single, 5 Pack. Choose yours above the Add to Cart button and the price updates to match, then set the quantity you need. Your choice appears in your cart and on your order confirmation, so there is no guessing at fulfillment.

## Who it suits
Citrus AMMO Nicotine Pouches suits adult nicotine users who want a discreet, device-free option and who are comfortable with a pouch format.

## Using and caring for it
Use only as directed on the can. Start with the lowest strength if you are new to nicotine pouches, keep a pouch in place for the time recommended on the label, and dispose of used pouches in a bin rather than on the ground. Store cans in a cool, dry place, close the lid after each use, and keep them away from children and pets. Nicotine is addictive.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order Citrus AMMO Nicotine Pouches online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by USPS or UPS. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
